title: fix: bump smol-toml and js-yaml to patch DoS vulnerabilities
author: julianocosta89
body:
## Summary

Bumps two transitive dependencies to patch known denial-of-service vulnerabilities flagged by OSV.dev.

- **smol-toml** `1.7.0` → `1.7.1` (pulled in via `markdownlint-cli`, root `package.json`)
  Fixes [GHSA-7w5x-hrqm-74c2](https://osv.dev/GHSA-7w5x-hrqm-74c2): `parse()` could enter an infinite loop on malformed TOML (e.g. a value followed by a comment with no trailing newline), pinning CPU at 100%.

- **js-yaml** `4.3.1` → `4.3.2` (pulled in via `@eslint/eslintrc`, `src/frontend/package.json`)
  Fixes [GHSA-2883-xcg3-v3hh](https://osv.dev/GHSA-2883-xcg3-v3hh): `maxTotalMergeKeys` didn't properly bound CPU consumption, allowing crafted YAML with repeated empty-mapping merges to cause excessive parse times.

Both are pinned via `overrides` in their respective `package.json` files, matching the existing override pattern already used in `src/frontend/package.json`.

## Out of scope

A third advisory, [RUSTSEC-2026-0258](https://osv.dev/RUSTSEC-2026-0258) (h2 unbounded empty DATA frames), affects `src/shipping/Cargo.lock` via `awc`/`actix-web`'s `http2` feature. Both `awc 3.8.2` and `actix-http 3.13.5` are the latest published releases and still hard-pin `h2 = "^0.3.27"`, which predates the fix (0.4.16+). There is no compatible upgrade path available upstream yet, so this isn't addressed here.

## Test plan

- [x] Regenerated lockfiles with `npm install --package-lock-only` in the root and `src/frontend`
- [x] Verified `smol-toml` resolves to `1.7.1` and `js-yaml` resolves to `4.3.2` in the respective lockfiles
- [x] Confirmed `eslint` still runs in `src/frontend` after the override

Assisted-by: Claude Sonnet 5
